chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about a man who embraced Islam in the middle of the month of Ramadan: what is required of him regarding his fasting?
He عليه السلام said: “He is not required to fast except for what remains from the time in which he embraced Islam, and he is not required to make up what has already passed of it.”

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the obligatory month of fasting
key_terms.مَا قَدْ مَضَى مِنْهُ: what had already passed from the month
key_terms.يَقْضِيَ: to make up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: If someone becomes Muslim in the middle of Ramadan, must he make up the earlier missed fasts?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a person who enters Islam during Ramadan. He is obligated only to fast the remaining days after becoming Muslim, and he does not make up the days of Ramadan that passed before his Islam.
